_animation_floors._sf_latency_note: SF-latency verdicts are single-run and NOT reproducible on their own. Three consecutive corrected runs of overlay-open on 1.25.0 (2026-09-12, 3T) gave FAIL, PASS, FAIL: a 67ms gap at the idle-to-animation boundary in two of three. One run is a sample, not a verdict — take the video path plus a vision read before recording any SF result here.
